sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Shows the app in dark colors when the system dark theme is on.
Stops usage events from reaching Firebase and Facebook, and disables Crashlytics and Firebase performance monitoring.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes banner, native, app open and interstitial ads, including the ad shown before sharing.
Removes the Athan Academy banner in the Quran tab, and the Academy popup and teacher feedback bar in the chapter reader.
Adds a Save to gallery option to the share sheet of verse, dua and greeting card images. Requires Android 10 or newer.
Unlocks Athan Premium, including the premium Quran themes and athans, and removes ads.
